recipes.name: Pan-Seared Salmon
steps: Dry the skin; season.
Sear skin-side down 4-5 min; flip 2-3 min to 145F.
Serve with lemon.
recipes.notes: Salmon raw is about 208 kcal, 20 g protein and 13 g fat per 100 g (USDA reference).

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon and Vegetables
steps: Roast vegetables with half the oil and salt at 425F 8 min.
Add salmon; roast 10-12 min to 145F.
recipes.notes: Fish overcooks in minutes; check early.

recipes.name: Lemon-Garlic Baked Cod
steps: Toss fillets with oil, garlic, paprika and salt.
Bake at 425F 10-12 min to 145F; finish with lemon.
recipes.notes: Very lean; about 82 kcal and 17.8 g protein per 100 g raw (USDA reference).

recipes.name: Easy Fish Tacos
steps: Season fish; pan-sear 3 min per side; flake.
Mix yogurt with lime juice for sauce.
Fill tortillas with fish, cabbage and sauce.

recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp Rice Bowl
steps: Saute shrimp in butter 2-3 min per side until pink and curled.
Add garlic, lemon and parsley.
Serve over rice.
recipes.notes: Shrimp is about 85 kcal and 20 g protein per 100 g raw (USDA reference).

recipes.name: Shrimp and Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Stir-fry vegetables 3 min with ginger and garlic.
Add shrimp and cook 2-3 min; add soy and honey.

recipes.name: Yogurt Tuna Salad
ing: cans light tuna in water, drained
steps: Mix; serve on rice, toast or greens.

recipes.name: Canned Salmon Patties
steps: Mix everything but the oil; form patties.
Cook 3-4 min per side until golden.
recipes.notes: Budget protein; canned salmon bones are edible and soft.

recipes.name: Simple Fish Chowder
steps: Sauté onion in butter; add potatoes and broth; simmer 12 min.
Add fish and milk; simmer 6-8 min without boiling.

recipes.name: Soft Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk eggs, milk and salt.
Cook in butter on low, stirring constantly, pulling before fully set.
recipes.notes: About 72 kcal and 6.3 g protein per large egg.

recipes.name: Batch Hard-Boiled Eggs
steps: Lower eggs into boiling water and boil 11-12 minutes.
Cool in ice water 5 minutes; refrigerate in the shell.
recipes.notes: Keeps 7 days refrigerated (USDA); do not freeze. 2 eggs per serving.

recipes.name: Egg Muffin Cups (batch breakfast)
steps: Grease a 12-cup muffin tin and fill with the mixed ingredients.
Bake at 350F 18-22 min to 160F.
recipes.notes: Keep 4 days refrigerated; freeze 2-3 months. 2 cups per serving.

recipes.name: Vegetable Frittata
steps: Sauté vegetables in an oven-safe skillet in oil.
Pour in whisked eggs, milk, cheese and salt; cook 2 min.
Bake at 375F 15-18 min to 160F.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion and pepper; add garlic, spices, tomatoes and salt; simmer 10 min.
Make wells and crack in eggs; cover 6-8 min until whites set.
Top with feta.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice

macros.basis: 3 eggs + 1.5 cups rice + 1/2 cup veg + oil + soy

steps: Scramble eggs in the oil and push aside.
Add vegetables then rice; fry 3-4 min until hot.
Stir in soy sauce and eggs.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk eggs with cottage cheese and salt.
Cook in butter on low, stirring, until just set.
recipes.notes: Cottage cheese adds about 12 g protein per 100 g.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dal
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices 3 min.
Add lentils and water; simmer 15-20 min until creamy.
Finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Black Beans and Rice
steps: Simmer soaked beans with onion, garlic, spices and bay leaf 60-90 min (or pressure 25-30 min unsoaked).
Salt near the end; serve over rice with salsa.
recipes.notes: 1 lb dry beans is about 6 cups cooked.

recipes.name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and salt; simmer 15 min.
Stir in spinach.

recipes.name: Crispy Baked Tofu
steps: Cube pressed tofu; toss with soy, cornstarch, oil and garlic powder.
Bake at 400F 25-30 min, flipping once.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble
steps: Sauté crumbled tofu in oil with turmeric and salt 5 min.
Wilt in spinach.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Sauté onion, carrots and garlic.
Add lentils, tomatoes, water and seasoning; simmer 30-35 min.
Serve over cooked pasta.

recipes.name: Three-Bean Salad
steps: Toss everything; rest 30 min.
recipes.notes: Keeps 5 days. Cheap protein and fiber.
